# #448 Mange bygger kassa

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-09-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Market Makers (recorded 9 Sep 2026) looks at the gap between Swedish large caps and small caps. The Stockholm index has risen about 20-30%, while small caps have returned almost nothing even though their earnings grew faster, and a Pinpoint Q2 study shows revenue and EBIT beating estimates. One host is building cash ahead of what is usually a weak September because of the risk of commodity-driven inflation, with European gas up 200% and copper at record highs. Company picks include a long-term starter position in Norbit and a bullish look at Glencore, Lundin Mining and Hudbay Minerals as copper plays. The episode ends with a sponsored interview with Nordamps, a semiconductor company going public.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NORBT — Norbit | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host bought a small position; quality engineering company with 30% CAGR and 21% EBIT margin, derated to EV/EBIT 16; CEO insider buy; target of 19%/yr organic growth to 2030.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion: after an 18-month slide, valuation has halved (EV/EBIT 16 vs ~35 at the peak) while earnings kept growing. Track record is strong: long-term targets hit 2 of 3 times, CEO bought ~0.5 MSEK of shares. Near-term headwinds (a large order may slip to next year, strong NOK hurting exports, lock-up expiry Sep 17) look priced in. The host keeps the position small until operational momentum or triggers appear.

#### Sell Triggers

- large order slips and guidance lands at the low end, missing estimates
- continued NOK strength hurting exports
- the second-largest owner sells via the open market after the lock-up expires
- failure to track the 19% organic growth target

> *"Så sammanfattningsvis, kanske inte något superläge på kort sikt, men långsiktigt så tror jag nog att det kan vara en bra pjäs i väskan."*

---

### 🟠 GLEN — Glencore | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Copper + coal play at ~5x EBITDA 2026 vs ~8x for copper majors; coal effectively free; H2 coal margins may double; ASX dual listing in October as a trigger. Host doesn't own it yet.

#### Reasoning

Guest/host Fabian: record copper prices and a thin supply pipeline support copper prices long term. A sum-of-the-parts check (copper + trading at 8x) means the coal segment comes for free. Coal gives a built-in hedge against rising energy prices that squeeze other miners' margins. The October ASX dual listing could re-rate the stock. He has only just started looking at it and does not own it.

#### Sell Triggers

- copper supercycle fails and prices reverse (2027 becomes a new 2024)
- coal and gas prices fall back in H2
- ASX dual listing delayed or poorly received

> *"Och jag äger inte Glencore just nu kan jag säga rakt ut, jag har precis börjat kolla på det här."*

---

### 🟠 LUMI — Lundin Mining | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Mid-tier copper miner at a 20-30% discount to majors; possible M&A target in a copper upcycle.

#### Reasoning

Host view: mid-tier and junior copper miners look attractive as copper rises. In the last cycle, majors bought most smaller players, and majors have few other ways to grow production. Risk: high H2 energy prices squeezing miner margins.

#### Sell Triggers

- copper price reversal
- high energy prices compress mining margins
- no M&A consolidation

> *"Bolag som Lundin Mining. Hudbay Minerals. De handlas till typ en 20-30% rabatt mot de större spelarna."*

---

### 🟠 HBM — Hudbay Minerals | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Mid-tier copper miner at a 20-30% discount to majors; possible takeover candidate.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis as Lundin Mining: copper at record highs with shrinking supply, smaller miners cheap relative to majors, and a history of majors acquiring mid-tiers. Energy cost inflation is the main risk to margins.

#### Sell Triggers

- copper price reversal
- high energy prices compress margins
- no M&A consolidation

> *"Bolag som Lundin Mining. Hudbay Minerals. De handlas till typ en 20-30% rabatt mot de större spelarna."*
